items.source: By default this is set to "guest".

items.source: See class-level documentation for more information on the "system" connection.
items.translation: 有关“system"连接的更多信息，请参阅类级别文档。

items.source: For each new CONNECT message, an independent TCP connection to the broker is opened and used exclusively for all messages from the client that originated the CONNECT message. Messages from the same client are identified through the session id message header. Reversely, when the STOMP broker sends messages back on the TCP connection, those messages are enriched with the session id of the client and sent back downstream through the MessageChannel provided to the constructor.
items.translation: 对于每个新的 `CONNECT` 消息，都会向代理打开一个独立的 TCP 连接，并专用于该客户端发送的所有源自 `CONNECT` 消息的消息。来自同一客户端的消息通过会话 ID 消息头进行标识。反之，当 STOMP 代理在 TCP 连接上回送消息时，这些消息会附加客户端的会话 ID，并通过提供给构造器的 `MessageChannel` 接口向下游发送。

items.source: By default ReactorNettyTcpClient is used.
items.translation: 默认情况下，使用ReactorNettyTcpClient。

items.source:
This class also automatically opens a default "system" TCP connection to the
message broker that is used for sending messages that originate from the server
application (as opposed to from a client). Such messages are not associated with
any client and therefore do not have a session id header. The "system" connection
is effectively shared and cannot be used to receive messages. Several properties
are provided to configure the "system" connection including:
items.translation: 该类还会自动向消息代理打开一个默认的“系统”TCP 连接，用于发送源自服务器应用程序（而非客户端）的消息。此类消息不与任何客户端关联，因此没有会话 ID 标头。“系统”连接实际上是共享的，不能用于接收消息。提供了若干属性来配置“系统”连接，包括：

items.source: The default value is 10000.
items.translation: 默认值为 10000。

items.source:
This is for internal use in a multi-application server scenario where
servers forward messages to each other (for example, unresolved user destinations).
items.translation: 此功能用于多应用服务器场景的内部处理，其中服务器会相互转发消息（例如未解析的用户目标）。

items.source: By default this property is not set.
items.translation: 默认情况下，该属性未设置。

items.source: Configure the TaskScheduler to use to reset client-to-broker message count in the current heartbeat period. For more details, see StompBrokerRelayRegistration.setTaskScheduler(TaskScheduler).
items.translation: 配置 TaskScheduler 用于在当前心跳周期内重置客户端到代理的消息计数。有关详细信息，请参阅StompBrokerRelayRegistration.setTaskScheduler(TaskScheduler)。

items.source: Configure a MessageHeaderInitializer to apply to the headers of all messages created through the StompBrokerRelayMessageHandler that are sent to the client outbound message channel.
items.translation: 配置一个 `MessageHeaderInitializer`，使其适用于通过 `StompBrokerRelayMessageHandler` 创建并发送到客户端出站消息通道的所有消息的标头。
